# Citad3L

> Citad3L is a private, less-filtered AI chat app at https://citad3l.io, founded by Cruz Garza. You can chat with text models, generate images, and make short video clips. Adult text chat between adults is allowed. The only hard lines are no sexual content involving minors and nothing about bombs or explosives. Image mode keeps a safety filter and will not produce explicit nude or sexual images.

This file is a plain summary for AI tools and search engines. Everything here is also stated on the public pages linked below.

## Models

- Citad3L V1 Fast: uncensored chat and the swarm lead. Supports web search and extended thinking for signed-in users, and can look at uploaded images.
- Citad3L Image: generates images from a written prompt (or type /image followed by a prompt in chat). Pro and Max. Keeps a safety filter and will not produce explicit nude or sexual images.
- Citad3L Private: chat in a verified secure enclave (text only, signed-in). The browser sends the message to Citad3L's server over HTTPS. The server reads it, runs a safety check, then encrypts it to the enclave. This is not end-to-end encryption from the device.
- Swarm mode: V1 Fast plans, up to three workers answer parts in parallel, V1 Fast writes the reply (signed-in).
- Citad3L Video: 5-second 720p clips with sound (Max plan).
- More chat models. Free: Gemma 4 Uncensored, Uncensored 1.2 and GLM 5.3 Flash Uncensored (no account needed). Pro adds Role Play Uncensored, Inkling 2 Mini and Qwen 3.8 27B. Max adds Qwen 4 Max, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3.1 Pro and Kimi K2.7 Code. These are not end-to-end encrypted.

## Plans

- Free: try Citad3L with no card. Guests get five successful replies without an account; failed or stopped replies never count. A free account gets 3 messages every day across the 5 named Free models (V1 Fast, Private, Gemma 4 Uncensored, Uncensored 1.2, GLM 5.3 Flash Uncensored), resetting at midnight Central.
- Pro: $20 per month (25 replies every 5 hours, up to 150 a week), adds Role Play Uncensored, Inkling 2 Mini, Qwen 3.8 27B and Citad3L Image.
- Max: $50 per month, 2.5x the Pro allowance, adds Qwen 4 Max, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3.1 Pro, Kimi K2.7 Code, Citad3L Video and per-model settings.
- Paid plans are open. Subscribe on the pricing page. They renew monthly until you cancel. First-time buyers, through January 31, 2027: Pro is $10 the first month, then $20/month. Max is $25 the first month, then $50/month. Checkout applies that price.

## Sign-in

- Enter your email and Citad3L sends a 6-digit code. There are no passwords.
- Signed-in users can export or delete their data from their account.
